Figure 1 Overview of adaptations in agentic Al. Agent: the foundation models serving as orchestration and reasoning modules; /Jool: callable components other than the agent model that operate independently, e.g., APIs, ML models, subagents, or memory. We categorize these adaptations into two: agent adaptation (Al & AZ): adapting agent models, and tool adaptation (11 & 12}: adapting tools for agents. See more details in $3.
